title: ICAB Chartered Accountancy (CA)
body: The Institute of Chartered Accountants of Bangladesh (ICAB)
source: ICAB 'How to become a CA' Brochure (25 September 2024)
summary: The ICAB CA qualification comprises three progressive examination levels (Certificate, Professional, and Advanced), a mandatory articleship at an approved CA firm, and ethics/professional training. Entry requirements and articleship duration vary based on your academic path.

grad.name: Graduate (Honours / Masters)
grad.blurb: For graduates and post-graduates in any discipline. Articleship duration is 3 years, with exams taken in parallel.

nodes.name: Meet Academic Criteria
nodes.description: Graduation or post-graduation in any discipline with at least 7 points in total and at least 2 points at each level up to graduation from a recognised board/university (CGPA 3.0+ = 3 points, CGPA 2.0-2.99 = 2 points).

nodes.name: Claim University Exemptions (CPL)
nodes.description: If your university department has an ICAB MoU or Credit for Prior Learning (CPL) agreement, submit transcripts to claim subject-wise Certificate Level exemptions.

nodes.name: Register with an Approved CA Firm
nodes.description: Secure a position as an articled student at an ICAB-approved Chartered Accountancy firm. Receive the monthly student allowance prescribed by ICAB.

nodes.name: Pre-Articleship Training Course (PATC)
nodes.description: Mandatory 1-month intensive course on Audit & Assurance fundamentals and English business communication before commencing firm duties.

nodes.name: Complete 3-Year Articleship
nodes.description: Undergo 3 full years of supervised audit, tax, advisory, and accounting practical training at the firm.

nodes.name: Accounting
nodes.description: Foundations of financial accounting, double-entry mechanics, and statutory financial statement preparation.

nodes.name: Assurance
nodes.description: Fundamentals of audit and assurance services, internal control mechanisms, and professional scepticism.

nodes.name: Business, Technology and Finance
nodes.description: Organizational management, technology integration in business operations, and capital finance basics.

nodes.name: Management Information
nodes.description: Costing methodologies, budgeting techniques, and management decision support systems.

nodes.name: Principles of Taxation
nodes.description: Fundamentals of Bangladesh direct and indirect tax laws, income tax rules, and VAT.

nodes.name: Business Laws
nodes.description: Bangladesh legal framework governing contracts, sales of goods, partnerships, and negotiable instruments.

nodes.name: Information Technology
nodes.description: Information systems, cybersecurity foundations, cloud enterprise computing, and database essentials.

nodes.name: Financial Accounting and Reporting
nodes.description: Complex IFRS/IAS standards, group accounts, consolidated statements, and practical accounting scenarios.

nodes.name: Audit and Assurance
nodes.description: Audit execution under International Standards on Auditing (ISA), risk assessments, and reporting.

nodes.name: Business Planning: Taxation & Compliance
nodes.description: Corporate tax planning, fiscal compliance, assessments, appeals, and VAT administration in Bangladesh.

nodes.name: Financial Management
nodes.description: Capital budgeting, cost of capital, dividend policy, financial restructuring, and risk management.

nodes.name: Business Strategy and Technology
nodes.description: Strategic analysis, competitive positioning, business model innovation, and technology adoption.

nodes.name: Corporate Laws and Practices
nodes.description: Bangladesh Companies Act, SEC guidelines, corporate governance codes, and winding-up procedures.

nodes.name: IT Governance
nodes.description: IT risk frameworks, internal audit of IT systems, COBIT alignment, and digital control security.

stages.title: Advanced Level (AL)
stages.subtitle: 2 integrated strategic papers & the Capstone Case Study

nodes.name: Corporate Reporting
nodes.description: Advanced multi-entity financial reporting, forensic review, auditing ethics, and corporate governance integration.

nodes.name: Strategic Business Management & Leadership
nodes.description: Senior executive decision-making integrating financial strategy, risk management, and organizational leadership.

nodes.name: Case Study
nodes.description: The capstone four-hour integrated business simulation requiring a comprehensive board-level advisory report.

nodes.name: Ethics & Professional Development
nodes.description: Complete mandatory professional ethics modules and continuous professional development (CPD) requirements.

nodes.name: ICAB Associate Membership (ACA)
nodes.description: Submit articleship completion verification and exam transcripts to be formally admitted as an Associate Chartered Accountant (ACA).

hsc.name: HSC / A Level
hsc.blurb: Direct entry route after HSC, A Level, or equivalent. Articleship duration is 4 years (3.5 years for high A Level achievers).

nodes.name: Academic Merit Requirements
nodes.description: Minimum aggregate GPA 8.0 in SSC & HSC combined, or minimum 36 O Level points (5-7 subjects) and 12 A Level points (up to 3 subjects).

nodes.name: Register with an Approved CA Firm
nodes.description: Join an ICAB-approved firm directly. Fast-track to 3.5 years if achieving Grade A in three A Level subjects with required O Levels.

nodes.name: Pre-Articleship Training Course (PATC)
nodes.description: Mandatory 1-month course on Audit & Assurance fundamentals and English business communication.

nodes.name: Complete 4-Year Articleship
nodes.description: 4 years of hands-on articleship training concurrently with examination attempts.

pas.name: Pre-Articleship Student (PAS)
pas.blurb: For enrolled university students. Sit exams up to Professional Level before joining a firm, unlocking shortened articleship (2.5 or 2 years).

nodes.name: Verify PAS Eligibility
nodes.description: Must be currently enrolled in an undergraduate or post-graduate program at a recognised university and meet general academic point criteria.

nodes.name: Register as PAS & Attend Coaching
nodes.description: Register under the PAS wing. Maintain at least 50% mandatory class attendance per paper to earn exam eligibility.

nodes.name: Apply Academic Exemptions (CPL)
nodes.description: If your university department has an ICAB agreement, claim eligible exemptions early so you can advance to higher papers.

stages.title: Transition to Articleship
stages.subtitle: Shortened duration based on papers cleared

nodes.name: Join CA Firm within 1 Year
nodes.description: PAS exam credits remain valid for 1 year from your final university exam date. Join an approved firm within this window.

nodes.name: Pre-Articleship Training Course (PATC)
nodes.description: Complete the mandatory 1-month course prior to starting work.

nodes.name: Shortened Articleship Period
nodes.description: Articleship is reduced to 2.5 years (30 months) if Certificate Level is completed, and down to 2 years (24 months) if Professional Level is completed.

pro.name: ACCA / ICMAB Members
pro.blurb: Direct pathways for ACCA affiliates/members and ICMAB ACMA/FCMA members. Major exemptions and 2-year articleship.

stages.title: Check Eligibility & Exemptions
stages.subtitle: Credit for Prior Learning (CPL) for qualified members

nodes.name: Verify Qualified Membership Status
nodes.description: Must hold full ACCA membership/affiliate status or ICMAB ACMA/FCMA designation (excluding reciprocal pathways via third bodies).

nodes.name: Claim 7 Certificate + Selected PL Papers
nodes.description: Exempt from all 7 Certificate papers. ICMAB: exempt from PL Business Strategy, Corporate Law, IT Governance. ACCA: exempt from PL Business Strategy, IT Governance, and Audit & Assurance (if AAA completed in ACCA).

nodes.name: Register with an Approved CA Firm
nodes.description: Register under an approved ICAB principal for the specialized 2-year articleship term.

nodes.name: Pre-Articleship Training Course (PATC)
nodes.description: Complete mandatory 1-month training course.

nodes.name: Complete 2-Year Articleship
nodes.description: 24 months of specialized articleship training (can be completed concurrently or following PL exam attempts).

nodes.name: Financial Accounting and Reporting
nodes.description: Complex IFRS/IAS standards, group accounts, consolidated statements, and practical accounting scenarios.

nodes.name: Audit and Assurance

nodes.name: Financial Management

nodes.name: Corporate Laws and Practices
nodes.description: Required for ACCA candidates; exempt for ICMAB members.
